_notes: Hillsbrad boss / named-rare loot (2026-10-27). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

Field Marshal Calder.name: Hillsbrad Field Blade
Field Marshal Calder.flavor_text: Kept sharp for a war that never came this far south.

Field Marshal Calder.name: Marshal's Muster Tabard
Field Marshal Calder.flavor_text: Stitched with the sheaf-and-sickle of the Hillsbrad fields.

Field Marshal Calder.name: Furrowed Oath-Ring
Field Marshal Calder.flavor_text: He swore on the soil. The soil kept its half.

Field Marshal Calder.name: Militia Drill Gauntlets
Field Marshal Calder.flavor_text: Worn smooth where a hundred recruits were corrected.

Old Icehide.name: Icehide Pelt Cloak
Old Icehide.flavor_text: Still cold to the touch, a long way below the snowline.

Old Icehide.name: Yeti-Tooth Gouger
Old Icehide.flavor_text: A tooth the size of a forearm, lashed to a haft.

Old Icehide.name: Pasture-Walker's Boots
Old Icehide.flavor_text: The ram tracks stop here. So did the shepherd.

Old Icehide.name: Hoarfrost Charm
Old Icehide.flavor_text: Frost beads on it even in the sun.

Bloodtide Harpooner.name: Daggerspine Harpoon
Bloodtide Harpooner.flavor_text: Barbed so it cannot be drawn back out.

Bloodtide Harpooner.name: Bloodtide Scale Vest
Bloodtide Harpooner.flavor_text: Scales overlapping the wrong way, like a fish turned inside out.

Bloodtide Harpooner.name: Harpooner's Coil Belt
Bloodtide Harpooner.flavor_text: Rope burn worn into the leather in a spiral.

Bloodtide Harpooner.name: Strand-Drowned Pearl
Bloodtide Harpooner.flavor_text: Grey, and warm, which a pearl should not be.

Bosun Harlow.name: Southshore Cutlass
Bosun Harlow.flavor_text: Harbour-issue, and used far outside the harbour.

Bosun Harlow.name: Bosun's Storm Coat
Bosun Harlow.flavor_text: Salt has gone through it so often the cloth has given up.

Bosun Harlow.name: Press-Gang Shackles
Bosun Harlow.flavor_text: Three sets of initials filed into the inside.

Bosun Harlow.name: Harbourmaster's Signet
Bosun Harlow.flavor_text: Opens a strongbox nobody has found yet.

The Tidewrack.name: Tidewrack Anchor-Maul
The Tidewrack.flavor_text: The chain is still attached. So is some of the ship.

The Tidewrack.name: Drowned Purgation Censer
The Tidewrack.flavor_text: Whatever it burned, the sea put out.

The Tidewrack.name: Castaway's Last Ring
The Tidewrack.flavor_text: Worn thin on the inside, turned and turned for years.

Queen Thistlewing.name: Thistlewing Stinger
Queen Thistlewing.flavor_text: Still twitches if you hold it wrong.

Queen Thistlewing.name: Orchard Queen's Carapace
Queen Thistlewing.flavor_text: Lacquer-hard, and the colour of windfall apples.

Queen Thistlewing.name: Hive-Warden's Veil
Queen Thistlewing.flavor_text: Gauze and wire. It did not save the orchardist.

Queen Thistlewing.name: Royal Jelly Phial
Queen Thistlewing.flavor_text: Sealed with wax. Faintly, it hums.

Overseer Ashlan Silvervein.name: Silvervein Overseer's Mattock
Overseer Ashlan Silvervein.flavor_text: Silver in the head, which is a waste, and he knew it.

Overseer Ashlan Silvervein.name: Azurelode Mail Hauberk
Overseer Ashlan Silvervein.flavor_text: Rings cut from the seam itself, blue in the lamplight.

Overseer Ashlan Silvervein.name: Sumpwater Signet
Overseer Ashlan Silvervein.flavor_text: Tarnished black, except where a thumb rubbed it.

Overseer Ashlan Silvervein.name: Vein-Chaser's Lamp
Overseer Ashlan Silvervein.flavor_text: Burned until the water reached it, and a while after.

Grimewick the Drowned.name: Pump-House Hammer
Grimewick the Drowned.flavor_text: Used to beat the pumps into working. It did not work.

Grimewick the Drowned.name: Boiler-Scalded Grips
Grimewick the Drowned.flavor_text: The leather took the heat so the hands did not. Mostly.

Grimewick the Drowned.name: Kobold Foreman's Candle
Grimewick the Drowned.flavor_text: He did take the candle. That was the whole problem.

Grimewick the Drowned.name: Drowned Works Pendant
Grimewick the Drowned.flavor_text: Brass, green with it, strung on boot-lace.

Deepmuck.name: Silt-Caked Carapace Shield
Deepmuck.flavor_text: Something grew this, and something else wore it.

Deepmuck.name: Deepmuck Hide Leggings
Deepmuck.flavor_text: Weeps brown water for a week after skinning.

Deepmuck.name: Sump-Dweller's Fang
Deepmuck.flavor_text: Serrated, and set the wrong way round.

Deepmuck.name: Stillwater Charm
Deepmuck.flavor_text: Holds a bead of water that will not evaporate.

Chief Grik.name: Mudsnout Chieftain's Cleaver
Chief Grik.flavor_text: Notched once for every farm between here and the hollow.

Chief Grik.name: Hollow-Chief's Hide Mantle
Chief Grik.flavor_text: Gnoll work: three hides, badly cured, worn proudly.

Chief Grik.name: Bone-Fetish Totem
Chief Grik.flavor_text: Rattles on its own in the dark. Gnolls find this funny.

Chief Grik.name: Pack-Runner's Treads
Chief Grik.flavor_text: Built for the long loping run, not for standing still.

Gavin the Fence.name: Fence's Quiet Dirk
Gavin the Fence.flavor_text: No maker's mark. That is the selling point.

Gavin the Fence.name: Stolen Dalaran Seal
Gavin the Fence.flavor_text: Worth more than everything else he had, and he knew it.

Gavin the Fence.name: Cutpurse's Clasp
Gavin the Fence.flavor_text: Opens silently. Everything of his does.

Warden Stillwater.name: Durnholde Warden's Greatsword
Warden Stillwater.flavor_text: A keep-guard's blade, kept long after the keep fell.

Warden Stillwater.name: Stillwater's Breastplate
Warden Stillwater.flavor_text: The Syndicate's violet painted over Durnholde's grey.

Warden Stillwater.name: Keep-Warden's Gorget
Warden Stillwater.flavor_text: Issued to men who were told to hold a ruin.

Warden Stillwater.name: Broken Garrison Band
Warden Stillwater.flavor_text: Snapped and re-soldered, badly, more than once.

Gorbash the Thick.name: Stead-Breaker Maul
Gorbash the Thick.flavor_text: The Nethanders built that barn in a season. This took an hour.

Gorbash the Thick.name: Ogre-Hide Girdle
Gorbash the Thick.flavor_text: A human could make a cloak from the offcut.

Gorbash the Thick.name: Thick-Skull Helm
Gorbash the Thick.flavor_text: Dented outward, which takes some doing.

Gorbash the Thick.name: Millstone Shard Charm
Gorbash the Thick.flavor_text: A chip off the stead's own millstone, worn as a trophy.

Sergeant Ironbeard.name: Dun Garok Mountaineer's Hammer
Sergeant Ironbeard.flavor_text: Dwarven make, and it shows in the balance.

Sergeant Ironbeard.name: Ironbeard's Garrison Plate
Sergeant Ironbeard.flavor_text: Stormpike grey, with the fort's mark at the collar.

Sergeant Ironbeard.name: Rifleman's Powder Horn
Sergeant Ironbeard.flavor_text: Still dry inside, which in this country is an achievement.

Sergeant Ironbeard.name: Mountaineer's Studded Boots
Sergeant Ironbeard.flavor_text: Nailed for scree. Loud on flagstone.

Wall-Watcher Teague.name: Thoradin Border Pike
Wall-Watcher Teague.flavor_text: Long enough to keep Arathi on the other side of the stone.

Wall-Watcher Teague.name: Wall-Watcher's Hauberk
Wall-Watcher Teague.flavor_text: Thirty years on a wall nobody attacks.

Wall-Watcher Teague.name: Old Empire Signet
Wall-Watcher Teague.flavor_text: Thoradin's mark, worn to a suggestion.

Wall-Watcher Teague.name: Border Vigil Cloak
Wall-Watcher Teague.flavor_text: Faded on one shoulder only - the side the wind comes from.
